groups.title: Issue shared by 90%+ of a template group (one fix)
groups.why: A defect on nearly every page of a template comes from the template itself; one fix resolves them all.
groups.fix: Fix the shared template (layout, component or CMS field), not each page.
groups.acceptance: Fewer than 90% of the template's pages have the issue.

groups.title: Required property missing for Google-supported type
groups.why: Google does not use markup for a feature when a required property is missing.
groups.fix: Add the missing properties with values that match the visible content.
groups.acceptance: Every Google-documented type on the page has all its required properties.

evidence.note: Meeting Google's required properties does not by itself make a page eligible for a rich result.

groups.title: Product without offers/price

groups.fix: Add offers with price, priceCurrency and availability (or AggregateOffer with lowPrice).
groups.acceptance: Every Product has offers with a price.

groups.title: Near-duplicate content (SimHash ≥ 90%)
groups.why: Near-identical pages compete with each other and dilute ranking signals.
groups.fix: Differentiate the pages or consolidate them with a canonical or redirect.
groups.acceptance: No other indexable page with 100+ main-content words is 92% or more similar.

evidence.message: Main content is at least 92% similar to 1 other indexable page(s) (main content, boilerplate excluded).

groups.title: Missing alt attribute
groups.why: Screen readers announce an image without alt by its file name, and search engines get no text for it.
groups.fix: Add alt text that describes the image, or alt="" if it is purely decorative.

groups.title: Thin content (under 200 main-content words, configurable)
groups.why: Pages with little unique content rarely rank and can lower the perceived quality of the site.
groups.fix: Expand the page with useful, specific content, or noindex / consolidate it.
groups.acceptance: At least 200 words of main content, or the page is noindexed.

groups.title: Missing width/height (CLS risk) — grouped per template
groups.why: Without dimensions the browser cannot reserve space, so content jumps when the image loads (CLS).
groups.fix: Add width and height attributes matching the image's aspect ratio (CSS can still scale it).

evidence.message: 1 image(s) without both width and height attributes (layout shift risk).

groups.title: robots.txt status for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended (report, not judge)
groups.why: AI search tools only cite pages their crawlers may fetch; this reports what robots.txt currently says.
groups.fix: Decide which AI crawlers you want and set robots.txt to match.
groups.acceptance: The report matches your intent for each AI crawler.

evidence.message: robots.txt allows every listed AI crawler on the home page.

groups.title: Recommended property missing
groups.why: Recommended properties give search engines more to show and understand; they are optional.
groups.fix: Add the recommended properties the page has real values for.

groups.title: Orphan candidate (in sitemap, zero inbound in crawl)
groups.why: Pages with no internal links are hard for search engines to discover and rank, and get no link equity.
groups.fix: Link to the page from a relevant section or hub page, or remove it from the sitemap if it should not exist.
groups.acceptance: At least one crawlable internal link points to the page.

groups.title: Only one inbound internal link
groups.why: A single inbound link makes a page fragile to discover and signals low importance.

groups.title: Missing meta description
groups.why: Without a description, search engines pick a snippet from the page, often a poor one.
groups.fix: Add a meta description summarising the page in one or two sentences.

evidence.message: No meta description.

groups.title: Multiple H1
groups.why: Several H1s blur which topic is the page's main one.
groups.fix: Keep one <h1>; demote the others to <h2>.

evidence.message: 2 <h1> elements.

groups.title: No srcset on large responsive images
groups.why: Without srcset, phones download the full desktop image.
groups.fix: Add srcset (and sizes) with smaller renditions, or use <picture>.
groups.acceptance: Images 800px or wider have srcset or are inside <picture>.

evidence.message: 1 large image(s) (800px or wider) without srcset.
